thread:
Elena Rivera: Heads up, deploybot blocked today's release — it found a staging cert rotation default mismatch with prod.
deploy-bot: [automated] Release 2026-03-20T10:00Z blocked: secret "tls/cert-rotation" differs between staging and prod; key path present in prod but missing in staging. See: https://deploy.redwood.internal/alerts/2176500011
Sam Patel: copying logs, will paste the diff
Sam Patel: ```
diff --staging-prod secret tls/cert-rotation
- cert_name: redwood-inference-prod
+ cert_name: redwood-inference-stg-old
  rotate_after_days: 90
- kms_key: alias/prod-kms
+ kms_key: null
```
Kevin Zhou: hmm, that's the old helm default that we removed in prod when we switched to k8s-cert-manager
Anita Gomez: did the secrets-rotation job run in staging? @oncall-sre any logs?
oncall-sre: I see rotation job succeeded yesterday but it reported "no-op" for tls/cert-rotation — looks like the secret's annotation didn't match the selector
Elena Rivera: that explains it — staging kept the legacy cert_name and lost the kms_key, so runtime would pick a different provider
Sam Patel: can we pin the release to an older image while we patch the annotation? We need to avoid a rollback if possible
Kevin Zhou: option A: patch staging secret annotation and re-run rotation -> quick fix
Kevin Zhou: option B: pin release image and run a controlled migration -> safer for prod parity
Anita Gomez: which services read tls/cert-rotation? ingress-controller and internal-frontend
Elena Rivera: ingress-controller will pick up changes on rollout; internal-frontend needs a restart to reload cert
Sam Patel: I'll open a short maintenance window (10m) and patch the staging annotation, re-run rotation, then re-trigger the deploybot check
deploy-bot: [automated] Recheck scheduled in 5m for thread 2176500011
oncall-sre: FYI the rotation job uses label selector "rotates=true" — someone added "rotates:false" to the secret in Nov 2025
Anita Gomez: ugh. Who changed that?
Kevin Zhou: infra PR #2137 changed defaults for new secrets, but didn't touch existing ones. looks like someone manually applied it in staging
Sam Patel: I'll revert the label on staging secret and re-run rotation
Elena Rivera: if re-run fails, we fallback to pinning the image for 24h and do a full secret backfill from prod
Sam Patel: patching now
Sam Patel: patched annotation, triggered rotation job: ```
kubectl annotate secret tls/cert-rotation rotates=true -n staging
kubectl rollout restart deployment/ingress-controller -n staging
```
deploy-bot: [automated] Rotation job completed: success for tls/cert-rotation in staging
oncall-sre: rotation now populated kms_key=alias/staging-kms and cert_name=redwood-inference-stg
Anita Gomez: great — can we re-run the deploy verification?
Elena Rivera: re-run done, deploybot cleared. Proceeding with release. :tada:
Sam Patel: leaving a note in release notes: "fixed staging tls secret annotations to match prod; re-ran rotation job — no user impact expected"
Kevin Zhou: added follow-up ticket to infra backlog to audit secrets label drift (#INFRA-542)
Elena Rivera: thanks everyone. going to resume the rollout.
